title: docs(releases): curate the v16 release page — backend + Console coverage for 16.0.0
body:
## Summary

`content/docs/releases/v16.mdx` was missing while `@objectstack/spec` is already published at `16.0.0-rc.0` — the `check:release-notes` drift guard demands a curated page per released major. This adds the full v16 release page (backend **and** Console), wires it into `meta.json`, and updates the index (v15 marked final at 15.1.1).

## Sourcing

Per `docs/releases-maintenance.md`:

- **Backend** — the deduplicated `16.0.0-rc.0` changeset entries across all package `CHANGELOG.md`s (85 unique changesets: 2 major, ~30 minor, ~50 patch), plus the changeset-less approvals commits (#3268 / #3274 / #3282 / #3300) and capability-vocabulary work (#3281 / #3302) recovered from commit messages.
- **Console** — the bundled objectui delta `077e45b..94d4876` (the objectui **15.0.0 → 16.0.0** major, objectui #2589–#2705), from the three `@objectstack/console` bump changesets plus objectui commit bodies.

## Page structure (mirrors v15)

- **Highlights**, outcome-oriented.
- **Breaking changes & migration:** `organizationId` convergence (#3280/#3290), `DashboardWidgetSchema.strict()` (#3251, protocol step16), MCP stdio API-key principal + own switch (ADR-0101/#3167), feed-surface retirement (#1959/#3180), the #2377 enforce-or-remove sweep (dead field/object/agent props, 18→8 hook events, dead validation/webhook triggers, `js` dialect), engine-owned system objects (ADR-0103/#3220), ADR-0099 P1 posture narrowing with its upgrade check, and `role` → `org_membership_level` (#3133).
- **Behavior changes:** import `passwordPolicy: 'auto'` default, `readonly` INSERT strip, bulk-update validation enforcement, transactional-batch API gates, `dateField == today()` fix, sandbox CPU-time budgets, better-auth system-context writes, platform-global tenancy fix.
- **New capabilities:** approvals quorum + per-group sign-off (会签) + declared decision actions, time-relative trigger (#1874), filtered roll-ups (#1868), `state_machine.initialStates`, flow-trigger observability, analytics drill ranges (#1752), Server-Timing spans (#2408), MCP `validate_expression`, capability vocabulary (#3265), typed `batchTransaction`, sandbox/bulk-write/seed/CLI hardening.
- **Console (Studio) — bundled objectui 16.0**, grouped by area: metadata-driven approvals inbox (#2678 line), ADR-0059 action-param widgets, dataset-only dashboard authoring, flow-designer nested regions (#2670), Gantt, Access pillar (#2600 B1–B5), lists/master-detail/detail, auth/login, platform fixes.
- **Upgrade checklist** and **References**.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-release-notes.mjs` → OK (every released major has a curated, navigable page).
- Every claim traced to a changeset entry, commit message, or objectui commit body in the bundled range; the RC status is called out explicitly on the page.
